Fix that ends the class: the guard reads every html node's raw value loosely for opens (any '', case-insensitive) and counts no close, so every block from the first such node to the end of the file compares exactly. Only html node values reach GitHub's HTML parser unescaped, so no verbatim element can open before that point.
